**Subject: We're moving! Carver Avenue, December 12-13**

Hi team,

Big news: we're moving into our new space on Carver Avenue! Here's what you need to know.

**📍 New address**
[Street number] Carver Avenue, [City, State ZIP]
Our first day in the new office is **Monday, December 14**.

**🏠 Remote days before the move**
So the movers can pack up Fourth Street, everyone will work remotely for three days:
- Wednesday, December 9
- Thursday, December 10
- Friday, December 11

Please take home your laptop, charger, and any personal items you need. The movers will pack everything else on the 12th and 13th.

**🪑 Desk assignments**
You can find your new desk in [location, e.g. the shared "Carver Ave Seating Chart" doc / link]. Please check it by [date] and tell [name] if something looks wrong.

**💻 IT setup**
Questions about monitors, docking stations, Wi-Fi, or anything else tech? Reach out to **[name]** at [email/Slack handle]. They'll have your workstation ready for Monday.

**Before you leave Fourth Street**
- Clear out your desk and take home any personal belongings and valuables.
- Label any items you want to keep with you rather than have moved.

We know moves can be disruptive, so thank you for your flexibility. We're excited to see everyone in the new space!

Questions? Just ask [name/contact].

Thanks,
[Your name]

---
